_meta.note: Used ONLY to define enchantment names mentioned bare in event/reward text (e.g. 'Enchant ... with Glam') — enchanted cards themselves carry the game's resolved enchantment text in their DTO. Values with X are per-instance; the card's own text shows the real number.
missing: Slither and Slumbering Essence exist in the game (Models.Enchantments) but have no wiki entry; add definitions from the game's localization if they ever appear by name in event text.

enchantments.Adroit: This card also gains X Block.
enchantments.Clone: This card can be duplicated at Rest Sites.
enchantments.Corrupted: This card deals 50% more damage, but you lose 2 HP when playing it.
enchantments.Glam: This card has Replay once per combat (played an additional time).
enchantments.Goopy: This card gains Exhaust; each play permanently increases its Block by 1.
enchantments.Imbued: This card is played automatically at the start of each combat.
enchantments.Inky: This card deals 1 additional damage and applies 1 Weak.
enchantments.Instinct: This card's attack damage is doubled.
enchantments.Momentum: This card's attack damage increases by X this combat each time it is played.
enchantments.Nimble: This card's Block is increased by X.
enchantments.Perfect Fit: When this card would be shuffled into the draw pile, it goes on top instead.
enchantments.Royally Approved: This card gains Innate and Retain.
enchantments.Sharp: This card's damage is increased by X.
enchantments.Swift: The first time you play this card, draw X cards.
enchantments.Sown: The first time you play this card each combat, gain Energy.
enchantments.Spiral: This card gains Replay 1 (played an additional time).
enchantments.Tezcatara's Ember: This card costs 0, deals 3 additional damage, and gains Eternal.
enchantments.Vigorous: The first time this card is played, it deals X additional damage.
